dimensions.assessment: Affects small businesses applying for federal contracting programs and SBA administrators compiling reports.
dimensions.evidence: requires the Small Business Administration (SBA) to report annually... information about specified SBA contracting programs.

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and transparency effects via reporting data on application counts, denials, and processing times.
dimensions.evidence: the total number of unique small business concerns certified for participation in a covered contracting program

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are specified in the text.
Amends the Small Business Act to add extensive, specific annual reporting requirements for multiple socioeconomic contracting programs.
dimensions.evidence: Section 10(c) of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 639(c)) is amended to read as follows

dimensions.assessment: Permanent annual reporting obligation tied to the President's budget submission.
dimensions.evidence: Along with the submission to Congress of the budget of the President for each fiscal year... the Administrator shall submit a report

missing_information: Cost to the SBA of compiling the detailed metrics required for the new annual reports
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates annual reporting by the Small Business Administration regarding several small business contracting and certification programs. It changes reporting requirements rather than creating new benefits or direct economic programs.
